none: PAS NLM-F2224B: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Theodosius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of House of Theodosius (379-395), Victory left issue of 388-395, Reece period 21. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: possibly blundered, appears as RORCA[--]S P[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath. Reverse inscription: VICTORIA AVGGG. Diameter: 13.0mm, Weight: 1.09gms, die axis: 6
